name: first-200-valid-prospective-issues-v1
success_definition: At least one of three distinct predicted digits is present anywhere in the three-digit drawn outcome
null_model: Independent uniform digits at each of three positions
reporting_policy: No p-values or significance verdict before 200 actual valid, sealed, post-registration predictions. After 200 compute one frozen fixed-window test per arm; daily cumulative success-rate table remains descriptive only.
limitations: Absent OpenCode results must be counted as coverage loss, never as failed predictions.
All tests rely on iid uniform three-digit outcomes and genuinely pre-result sealed forecasts.
Per-model first 200 valid votes may cover different issue dates; cross-model superiority is not established by separate p-values.
Do not repeatedly inspect a partial window and assert significance or tune models in response.
A rejection of the ideal-random null is not proof of a profitable betting strategy.
